_comment: A film released last month that nobody has voted on yet: vote_count 0 and
vote_average 0. The keep rule has to keep it on the strength of its release
date alone (within 730 days), and the mapper has to write no external_scores
row at all rather than a zero, because a 0 in that column reads as a verdict
Also the fixture for a title with no availability anywhere: watch/providers
comes back with an empty results object, which is what TMDB sends for a film
JustWatch has no offers for. The reconciliation still has to run for the
requested regions, or a film that has left every service could never say so.
